title: A Sharp Threshold Bound for Monotone Graph Properties

abstractEnglish: We prove the Friedgut–Kalai sharp-threshold conjecture. For every integer n ≥ 2, every nontrivial increasing family of graphs on n vertices invariant under all vertex permutations, and every $`0\lt \varepsilon\lt 1/2`$, the edge probabilities at which its probability equals ε and $`1-\varepsilon`$ differ by at most $`C\log(1/(2\varepsilon))/(\log n)^2`$, for a universal constant C.
